Actually OIML-CS has two schemes: Scheme A (certificates issued by issuing authorities based on test reports) and Scheme B (MAA - Mutual Acceptance Arrangement). This certificate is from 2008, under the old OIML certificate system. The certificate number format "R76/1992-NL1-08.30" — this is the classic OIML certificate system. Scheme...
